AI-exposed jobs are seeing the largest pay growth in the US:

Advertised pay in the most AI-exposed occupations has surged +46% since the start of 2021.

At the same time, moderately AI-exposed jobs have seen +41% growth.

This compares to a +39% increase in all US posted wages
